body:
## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in Madrid, Spain. It starts at Calle del Padre Damián, 3.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> Real Madrid's Bernabéu stadium is one of the most iconic in football. During this Bernabéu tour you can discover the magic that lives inside the home of _Los Blancos_.
>
> This Bernabéu tour includes a panoramic view of the stadium, access to the museum and temporary exhibitions, and the official shop. Thanks to interactive video displays in the on-site museum, you'll have the chance to relive the glory of Real Madrid's many achievements.
>
> Of course, it's not only used by Real Madrid – the Bernabéu has also hosted European Cup finals, the 2010 Champions League final, and Italy's 1982 World Cup Final victory.
>
> The stadium is filled with history, and if you love the beautiful game, then don't miss out on the chance to walk the same hallowed halls where some of the sport's greatest have stood.

## Price and rating

On 13 November 2026, WeGoTrip's product data listed it from €52.41. It was rated 4.5 out of 5 from 381 ratings and 113 written reviews. The final price is shown at WeGoTrip's checkout.

## Where this page comes from

This page was built on 13 November 2026 from WeGoTrip's partner data, the product information WeGoTrip gives its affiliates. We have not taken this tour ourselves, so check the listing for anything that matters to you before you book.
